{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"A black wool-blend blazer, sharp tailored fit with peak lapels, charcoal gray color (#36454F), heavy woven wool.
High-waisted wide-leg trousers in dark denim, straight leg cut reaching the ankle, deep indigo shade (#191970), sturdy cotton twill.

This outfit balances the desire for restraint and classic style with the practical needs of standing in a crowded club during an autumn evening concert. The blazer provides immediate structure and a timeless silhouette that stands up to artificial lighting without looking out of place, while the wide-leg denim offers comfortable movement through thick crowds. The dark denim pairs naturally with the black outer layer to elongate the legs, and the white silk camisole adds a touch of refined elegance at the neckline without breaking the cool color palette.
